BaseballPitch.start: The pitcher stands coiled on the mound gripping the ball with both hands, then begins a rotational wind-up, hips rotating forward as the throwing arm swings back.
BaseballPitch.middle: The pitcher's front leg drives forward as the arm accelerates and fully extends, releasing the ball, which arcs through the air toward home plate.
BaseballPitch.end: The pitcher completes the follow-through with torso angled downward, then lowers the arm and settles into a relaxed stance, eyes tracking the ball into the strike zone.
BaseballPitch.global: In a baseball pitch, the pitcher winds up rotationally on the mound and hurls the ball toward home plate with a full-body follow-through.

BasketballDunk.start: A player leaps from the court with arms extended toward the hoop, body fully airborne and knees tucked as the arms swing the ball toward the rim.
BasketballDunk.middle: The airborne player grips the ball firmly with fingers spread and drives it downward, body descending with legs straightening as the ball reaches the rim's edge.
BasketballDunk.end: The player's hand pushes the ball through the hoop into the net, then the body descends toward the court with arms still extended overhead.
BasketballDunk.global: A basketball dunk shows a player leaping high above the court and slamming the ball down through the hoop while fully airborne.

Billiards.start: A player leans over the green felt table in a bent posture, steadying the cue stick with both hands and aiming its tip just above the white ball.
Billiards.middle: The cue tip strikes the ball with a smooth forward stroke, sending the white ball rolling straight across the table while the player holds the bent stance.
Billiards.end: The ball drops into the pocket as the player straightens up, lowering the cue stick and relaxing the hands while eyeing the next ball.
Billiards.global: A billiards player bends over the felt table and strokes a cue stick, sending the white ball rolling across the surface into a pocket.

CleanAndJerk.start: The athlete stands over the barbell, dips at the hips and knees with a straight back, and lifts the bar from the ground by extending the legs.
CleanAndJerk.middle: The athlete pulls the barbell vertically to chest level with bending elbows, then extends the arms as the bar settles at the chest in an upright stance.
CleanAndJerk.end: The athlete drives the barbell overhead with arms fully extended, dips slightly and re-extends, then holds the bar locked out overhead with feet firmly planted.
CleanAndJerk.global: In a clean and jerk, a weightlifter hoists a barbell from the ground to the chest and then drives it overhead to a locked, stable hold.

CliffDiving.start: A diver stands at the edge of a steep cliff above churning water, then leaps outward and tucks the knees to the chest while rotating in midair.
CliffDiving.middle: The diver extends the legs into a streamlined vertical line and plunges into the water with a sharp splash, the body submerging beneath swirling foam.
CliffDiving.end: The diver resurfaces head first, straightens into a horizontal float, and glides calmly toward shore as ripples spread across the water.
CliffDiving.global: Cliff diving shows a diver leaping from a high rock face, rotating in midair, and plunging vertically into natural open water below.

CricketBowling.start: The bowler stands in a ready stance holding the ball, shifts weight forward, and rotates the arm backward to draw the ball behind the body.
CricketBowling.middle: The bowler's front leg extends as the arm swings forward in a powerful high arc, releasing the ball while the body leans into the follow-through.
CricketBowling.end: The ball arcs through the air toward the batsman while the bowler finishes in a high follow-through and settles into a balanced stance with arms relaxed.
CricketBowling.global: In cricket bowling, the bowler charges forward and whips a straight arm overhead to hurl the ball down the pitch toward the batsman.

CricketShot.start: The batsman stands on the grass pitch beside the wicket, knees bent and eyes on the ball, drawing the bat back in a wide two-handed arc.
CricketShot.middle: From a full backswing the bat sweeps forward and strikes the ball with a blur of motion, arms extending as the body rotates through the shot.
CricketShot.end: The bat slows through the follow-through toward the ground, the batsman's body fully rotated with arms trailing as the struck ball flies away.
CricketShot.global: A cricket shot shows a batsman on a grass pitch swinging the bat with both hands to strike the incoming ball away from the wicket.

Diving.start: A diver stands poised at the edge of the pool, leaps from the board, and tucks into a streamlined position with knees bent and head lowered.
Diving.middle: The diver rotates in midair, straightens the legs, and aligns the arms and head with the spine, holding a straight line just above the water surface.
Diving.end: The diver breaks the surface with a smooth splash, arms flaring slightly as the body sinks vertically, leaving a small circular ripple on the water.
Diving.global: In diving, an athlete springs from a board at a swimming pool, rotates through a tucked midair position, and enters the water in a streamlined vertical line.

FrisbeeCatch.start: A frisbee glides through the air toward the catcher, who extends both arms upward with fingers splayed and tilts the body to meet the curving disc.
FrisbeeCatch.middle: The catcher's torso rotates to align with the disc's flight as the extended fingers close around the glinting rim, gripping it firmly in midair.
FrisbeeCatch.end: The catcher pulls the disc inward toward the chest, bends the knees while descending, and lands softly with the frisbee held securely in the grip.
FrisbeeCatch.global: A frisbee catch shows a leaping player extending both arms to snatch a flying disc from the air and landing with it gripped firmly.

GolfSwing.start: The golfer stands over the ball on grass gripping the club with both hands and rotates into a slow backswing, raising the club head high overhead.
GolfSwing.middle: From the top of the backswing the golfer drives the club head down and through the ball, arms and torso rotating forward in one synchronized motion.
GolfSwing.end: The golfer's arms sweep into a full follow-through with the body rotated toward the target, holding the finish while the eyes track the ball's flight.
GolfSwing.global: A golf swing shows a golfer on a grass course coiling into a rotational backswing and whipping the club through the ball toward a distant target.

HammerThrow.start: The athlete grips the hammer handle with both hands and swings it in wide circular arcs overhead, hips and shoulders rotating with the building momentum.
HammerThrow.middle: The athlete pivots on the feet through fast rotations, body twisting as the hammer sweeps in a low horizontal plane and rises toward peak height.
HammerThrow.end: The athlete releases the hammer with a sharp snap of both hands, and it soars in a long arc before landing downfield as the thrower watches.
HammerThrow.global: In the hammer throw, an athlete whirls a wired ball in accelerating circles with both hands and releases it to fly far across the field.

HighJump.start: The athlete sprints along the track toward the raised horizontal bar and leaps upward, arms driving as the body begins to arch over it.
HighJump.middle: The athlete's body forms an inverted arch above the bar, hips rising and legs extending as the torso rotates to clear the crossbar.
HighJump.end: The athlete's legs swing down after clearing the bar and the body drops onto the cushioned mat, landing on the back and lying still.
HighJump.global: In the high jump, an athlete runs up to a horizontal bar and arches backward over it before landing safely on a padded mat.

JavelinThrow.start: The athlete holds the javelin high while facing the runway, pivoting and drawing the throwing arm backward as the body leans into the approach.
JavelinThrow.middle: The athlete's hips and shoulders twist sharply as the arm whips the javelin forward in a powerful overhead arc, releasing it with a snapping wrist.
JavelinThrow.end: The javelin sails through the air trailing a slight blur while the athlete decelerates in follow-through, watching it descend into the distant field.
JavelinThrow.global: In the javelin throw, an athlete strides forward and hurls a long spear overhead, sending it arcing far down the open field.

LongJump.start: The athlete starts from a standing position and sprints down the runway, arms pumping and body leaning forward with rapidly increasing speed.
LongJump.middle: The athlete plants a foot on the takeoff board and launches into the air, legs extending then tucking as the body sails forward at peak height.
LongJump.end: The athlete rotates slightly and swings the legs forward, landing feet first in the sandpit with bending knees and flaring arms absorbing the impact.
LongJump.global: In the long jump, an athlete sprints down a runway, springs from the takeoff board, and flies horizontally through the air into a sandpit landing.

PoleVault.start: The athlete sprints forward and plants the pole in the ground, gripping it tightly as it bends sharply under the driving force of the run.
PoleVault.middle: The recoiling pole lifts the athlete vertically as the body arches and twists upward, legs kicking skyward until the vaulter reaches peak height with arms extended.
PoleVault.end: The athlete twists and rotates during the descent, falling feet first toward the mat and landing in a tuck as the pole drops flat to the ground.
PoleVault.global: In the pole vault, an athlete sprints down the runway with a long pole, plants it, and rides its recoil upward to clear a great height.

Shotput.start: The athlete crouches in a bent posture with the shot tucked against the chest, coiling the body as the legs and hips shift to build rotation.
Shotput.middle: The athlete uncoils explosively, torso rotating as the arm punches forward and releases the shot, which arcs away while the free arm extends for balance.
Shotput.end: The athlete's arm follows through as the body completes its rotation, the free arm swinging across to stabilize a bent, balanced final stance.
Shotput.global: In the shot put, an athlete coils low in a bent posture and explosively rotates upward, pushing the heavy metal ball outward into a soaring arc.

SoccerPenalty.start: The player stands over the ball at the penalty spot with knees slightly bent, then swings the kicking leg back while the eyes stay fixed on the ball.
SoccerPenalty.middle: The player's foot drives forward and strikes the ball with the instep, compressing it visibly as the leg follows through and the body leans into the kick.
SoccerPenalty.end: The player finishes upright watching the ball arc and curve toward the goal, where it crosses the line and ripples the flapping net.
SoccerPenalty.global: A soccer penalty shows a lone player striding up to the penalty spot and driving the ball with one powerful kick into the goal net.

TennisSwing.start: The player holds the racket behind the body, then extends the arm forward so the racket head begins accelerating through the air toward the incoming ball.
TennisSwing.middle: The player's wrist snaps to square the racket face, which meets the ball in a blur of contact as it compresses against the strings.
TennisSwing.end: The racket sweeps diagonally across the body toward the opposite shoulder as the player rotates fully, finishing balanced with the arm relaxed after impact.
TennisSwing.global: A tennis swing shows a player on the court whipping the racket through a full arc to strike the ball cleanly off the strings.

ThrowDiscus.start: The athlete stands coiled with the discus in one hand, then pivots into a controlled turn, arm drawn back with the discus held close to the body.
ThrowDiscus.middle: The athlete drives through the rotation with knees bent, swinging the discus in a wide horizontal arc until the arm reaches maximum extension at shoulder height.
ThrowDiscus.end: The discus snaps free from the hand and sails in a flat horizontal arc while the athlete holds the follow-through, eyes tracking its long flight.
ThrowDiscus.global: In the discus throw, an athlete spins across the circle and slings the flat disc from an outstretched arm into a long horizontal flight.

VolleyballSpiking.start: The player leaps from the court with arms extended toward the ball hovering above the net, body rising as the striking arm swings up to load.
VolleyballSpiking.middle: The player's elbow bends sharply and the forearm accelerates, the open hand smashing the ball with a sharp downward strike above the net.
VolleyballSpiking.end: The player's arm follows through with wrist locked as the ball rockets downward, and the player lands softly on both feet with knees bent.
VolleyballSpiking.global: Volleyball spiking shows a player leaping high at the net and smashing the ball down into the opposing court with one explosive arm swing.
